# OnTimer

OnTimer is an iPhone calendar alarm app. It turns events from Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, and Outlook Calendar into automatic alarms that stay on screen until dismissed.

## Primary sources

- Product overview: https://www.ontimer.app/
- Features: https://www.ontimer.app/features

## Current product facts

- OnTimer is available for iPhone.
- It supports Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, and Outlook Calendar, including work and school accounts.
- Alarms stay on screen until dismissed.
- Users can choose alarm sounds and assign a sound to a specific event.
- Home-screen event cards control alarm on or off (for one occurrence or an entire repeating series), sound, Early Warning, and access to the original calendar event.
- Which Meetings Ring in Settings lets users choose Every meeting, Only meetings I choose, or Custom (recurring and one-off meetings set separately).
- Early Warning provides a lighter heads-up before the main alarm.
- Time To Leave can use an event location, travel time, and traffic.
- Time To Fly automatically discovers flights in connected calendars and prepares an airport leave-time alarm using the trip to the airport and airline-recommended arrival time.
- Time To Fly does not track flight status, delays, gates, terminals, check-in, security waits, or travel-document requirements.
- On iOS 26.1 and later, High Alert can ring through Silent mode and Focus or Do Not Disturb when enabled and permitted by iOS.
- Without High Alert, sound and delivery depend on iPhone notification, sound, and Focus settings.
- OnTimer is free and includes automatic alarms for one calendar provider.
- Time To Fly can set an initial airport departure estimate on the free plan. OnTimer Pro can update it for traffic when background conditions allow.
- OnTimer Pro also adds multiple calendar providers, Time To Leave, Early Warning, and additional controls.
